summary: Phase 4 passes at d2c8e6336. F41, F42, F50 and F51 are fixed and re-proved. All four gates pass. The sample of new claims found no false claim and four nonblocking wording nits.
nonblocking_findings: F52 [Nit] phase-acceptance: report.md:71, D3 bullet, says 'No commit and no gate'. The Per-class commits table at report.md:24 lists commit 409108d3e for D3. The true fact is that D3 has no test commit and no gate. Plan task 2.3 cites 409108d3e, a plan-only commit that closes Phase 2. Write 'No test commit' in the bullet. Label the table cell as a plan commit.

F53 [Nit] phase-acceptance: report.md:77 (Blog merge) and :86 name 'the phase-base test' with no commit. The base of this phase is e91c4d4cc, where the suite is already merged. The intended base is the Phase 3 base 8a126f612. At that commit the reader calls readFileSync on every .md name. Name 8a126f612 in both places.

F54 [Nit] phase-acceptance: report.md:201 cites gate-66aeb1011.json, green command, for 'shared runner with HEAVY_PREFLIGHT_WAIT_S=3600'. That field holds only the Vitest command. The gate note says 'through heavy-run'. No artifact records the wait variable for the final run. Cite the gate note and plan.md rule 6, or drop the variable.

F55 [Nit] phase-acceptance: report.md:73, D5 bullet, says 'The final case count is 3035 cases'. Section 1 gives 1412 as the final count. The 3035 count is the total after D5 part 4 (gate-407c5d9.json). Write 'The count after part 4 is 3035 cases'.
